earlier.challenge: CH shows J.C. Rathbone Associates came under new control on 1 Aug 2017, when J.C. Rathbone left the board. It kept filing full trading accounts through 2020 from its own office at 12 St James's Square, and in 2019 Chatham's UK executives Conly and Macdonald became its directors, while Chatham Financial Europe Ltd (04223247) sat at Tabernacle Street/Theobalds Road. So after the acquisition JCRA was probably the UK treasury-advisory company trading under the Chatham Financial brand, and a buyer could only have entered its number from the supplier's own papers, because a name search for 'Chatham Financial' never returns JCRA. The notice's date and supplier address would settle it: 2017–2021 with 12 St James's Square means JCRA's own number, and a Chatham Financial Europe address means related-company.

Clouds Environmental Consultancy Ltd was already registered at Utilitywise House by 2014 and filed full trading accounts for FY2014–FY2016 before going dormant, so it was the company actually running Utilitywise's 'Corporate' division. The notice's 'Utilitywise Corporate' is therefore best read as the brand Clouds traded under, and the number 04179455 as the org's own.
